StatusVariables.Name: BeamCurrent
StatusVariables.Description: Actual ion beam current

StatusVariables.Name: DoseAmount
StatusVariables.Description: Cumulative dose per scan

StatusVariables.Name: EnergyLevel
StatusVariables.Description: Acceleration energy

StatusVariables.Name: VacuumLevel
StatusVariables.Description: Chamber vacuum state

StatusVariables.Name: ScanPosition
StatusVariables.Description: Current beam X/Y position

StatusVariables.Name: WaferID
StatusVariables.Description: Current wafer identifier.

StatusVariables.Name: ActiveAlarmCount
StatusVariables.Description: Number of active alarm conditions.

StatusVariables.Name: LastAlarmID
StatusVariables.Description: Most recent alarm ID set or cleared.

StatusVariables.Name: LastRemoteCommand
StatusVariables.Description: Most recently received host command, including START alias or INITIALIZE.

StatusVariables.Name: LastCommandStatus
StatusVariables.Description: Status text for most recent command, such as ACCEPTED, REJECTED_PARAM, NOT_ALLOWED, COMPLETED.

StatusVariables.Name: CommandQueueCount
StatusVariables.Description: Number of host commands waiting in the command queue.

StatusVariables.Name: SpoolingState
StatusVariables.Description: Spooling state: INACTIVE, ACTIVE, TRANSMITTING, COMPLETE.

StatusVariables.Name: SpoolCount
StatusVariables.Description: Number of messages currently stored in the spool buffer.

StatusVariables.Name: SpoolCapacity
StatusVariables.Description: Maximum configured spool buffer capacity in messages.

StatusVariables.Name: ChamberPressure
StatusVariables.Description: Current chamber pressure in mTorr.

StatusVariables.Name: ChamberTemperature
StatusVariables.Description: Current chamber temperature in degrees C.

StatusVariables.Name: RFForwardPower
StatusVariables.Description: Current RF forward power in W.

StatusVariables.Name: RFReflectedPower
StatusVariables.Description: Current RF reflected power in W.

StatusVariables.Name: GasFlowRate
StatusVariables.Description: Total commanded/actual process gas flow in sccm.

StatusVariables.Name: PlasmaState
StatusVariables.Description: TRUE when plasma is ignited and stable.

StatusVariables.Name: EndpointStatus
StatusVariables.Description: Endpoint detection status: NOT_ACTIVE, SEARCHING, DETECTED, TIMEOUT.

StatusVariables.Name: Clock
StatusVariables.Description: Equipment date/time in YYYYMMDDhhmmss format.

Events.Description: Process sequence started; original ETCH-PRO naming may appear as ProcessStart.
Process sequence completed; original ETCH-PRO naming may appear as ProcessEnd.
Plasma ignition was attempted or achieved during process start.
Carrier/cassette is loaded and material context can be read.
Carrier/cassette is unloaded and lot processing context ends.
Alarm set or clear condition created a collection event context.
Process paused by host command or recoverable condition.
Paused process resumed by host command.
Process aborted by STOP, fault, or operator action.
Control state changed between OFF-LINE, LOCAL, or REMOTE.
HSMS selected and S1F13/S1F14 completed successfully.
TCP disconnect, HSMS deselect, or timeout caused loss of communication.
Spooling became active due to communication loss.
All requested spooled messages were transmitted to the host.

RemoteCommands.Description: Initialize the ion source and acceleration
Immediately stop wafer scanning and close shutter
Host-facing command alias for RCMD=INITIALIZE. Starts process setup and processing when accepted.
Canonical ETCH-PRO command that initializes and starts the process sequence. START maps to this command.
Stops or aborts active process according to safe-stop policy.
Pauses active process if current step supports pause.
Resumes process from PAUSED state after conditions are valid.

Clears ERROR state after alarms are resolved and returns process state to
IDLE.
Starts chamber pump-down sequence when idle and interlocks are safe.
Starts chamber vent sequence when idle or maintenance mode allows.
Runs chamber clean recipe or predefined clean cycle.

States.Name: DISABLED
States.Description:
SECS/GEM communication is disabled by configuration or operator action. Equipment
does not initiate or accept application messages.

States.Name: NOT SELECTED / NOT COMMUNICATING
States.Description:
Default communication state on power-up. TCP may be disconnected or HSMS not
selected; S1F13/S1F14 has not completed.

States.Name: SELECTED / COMMUNICATING
States.Description:
HSMS Select is complete and S1F13/S1F14 establish communications has completed with
COMMACK=0.

States.Name: OFF-LINE
States.Description:
Initial control state. Host command control is not permitted except communication and online
requests.

States.Name: ON-LINE LOCAL
States.Description:
Host may monitor and collect data. Process initiation and direct equipment control are
local/operator controlled.

States.Name: ON-LINE REMOTE
States.Description:
Host has remote control authority. S2F41 remote commands are accepted when process state and
parameters are valid.

States.Name: IDLE
States.Description:
Initial process state. Equipment is not processing, no active wafer in etch sequence, and START/INITIALIZE
may be accepted if in REMOTE.

States.Name: SETUP
States.Description: Recipe and material context are being validated; chamber preparation may start.

States.Name: PROCESSING
States.Description: Wafer etch is active; plasma, gas flow, RF power, pressure, and endpoint are monitored.

States.Name: PAUSED
States.Description: Processing is temporarily suspended by PAUSE or an interlock condition that permits resume.

States.Name: COMPLETING
States.Description: Etch sequence is ending, post-process purge/vent/robot handoff and result calculation are underway.

States.Name: ERROR
States.Description:
Fault state caused by critical alarm, failed command, unsafe pressure/temperature, or unrecoverable
transfer error.

StateTransitions.TriggerEvent:
CommunicationsEnabled=TRUE or operator enables host
communication.

HSMS Select succeeds and host/equipment complete
S1F13/S1F14 with COMMACK=0.

TCP disconnect, HSMS Deselect, T3/T7/T8 timeout, or
communication fault.

Operator or maintenance disables SECS/GEM
communication.

Host sends S1F17 and equipment accepts online request with ONLACK=0;
default online sub-state may be LOCAL.
Operator selects REMOTE or host/site policy grants remote control.
Operator selects LOCAL or remote mode is revoked.
Host sends S1F15 or operator selects OFF-LINE.

Host sends S1F15, communication failure policy forces offline, or operator
selects OFF-LINE.

Reports.Name: BeamStatusReport
Reports.Reasoning: Groups beam current, energy level, dose amount and vacuum/scan position to give full beam status beyond BeamStable event

Reports.Name: ScanStartReport
Reports.Reasoning: Combines wafer ID, target dose, scan count and current beam current to provide context for ScanStarted

Reports.Name: ScanCompleteReport
Reports.Reasoning: Enriches ScanCompleted with wafer ID, delivered dose, scan count and final scan position

Reports.Name: VacuumReadyReport
Reports.Reasoning: Adds beam current and energy level to vacuum level for a broader view of equipment readiness

Reports.Name: ProcessStartReport
Reports.Reasoning: Start of process includes recipe, wafer, lot, chamber and process state.

Reports.Name: ProcessCompletionReport
Reports.Reasoning: Completion includes timing, depth, duration, status and endpoint result.

Reports.Name: AlarmReport
Reports.Reasoning: Alarm report includes last alarm ID, count, command status and equipment states.

Reports.Name: ProcessResumeReport
Reports.Reasoning: Resume includes same context as pause.

Reports.Name: ProcessAbortReport
Reports.Reasoning: Abort includes process state, last alarm, command status, alarm count.

Reports.Name: ControlStateReport
Reports.Reasoning: Control state change includes control, communication, process states.

Reports.Name: CommunicationStateReport
Reports.Reasoning: Communication events include state, clock and process state.

Reports.Name: SpoolingReport
Reports.Reasoning: Spooling includes state, count, capacity and queue.

Reports.Name: SpoolTransmitCompleteReport
Reports.Reasoning: Spool transmit complete shares spooling context.

Reports.Name: TraceSummaryReport
Reports.Reasoning: Summary includes key identifiers and process state.

Questions.Question: Describe the process state machine transitions.
Questions.Answer:
The process is controlled by the **SpoolingState** status variable (ID 10012), which can take the four values **INACTIVE**, **ACTIVE**, **TRANSMITTING**, and **COMPLETE** [Source: Status Variable ID 10012].  

The transitions between these states are driven by the defined events:

| Current State | Event that triggers the transition | New State |
|---------------|-----------------------------------|-----------|
| **INACTIVE** | **ScanStarted** (ID 10202) – the wafer‑scan process is launched | **ACTIVE** [Source: Event ID 10202] |
| **ACTIVE** | **ProcessPaused** (ID 5301) – host command or a recoverable condition pauses the run | **PAUSED** (implicit; the process remains in a hold condition) [Source: Event ID 5301] |
| **PAUSED** | **ProcessResumed** (ID 5302) – host command resumes the run | **ACTIVE** [Source: Event ID 5302] |
| **ACTIVE** | **ProcessAborted** (ID 5303) – stop command, fault, or operator abort ends the run | **INACTIVE** [Source: Event ID 5303] |
| **ACTIVE** | Internal data‑transfer phase begins | **TRANSMITTING** [Source: SpoolingState values] |
| **TRANSMITTING** | Data transmission finishes | **COMPLETE** [Source: SpoolingState values] |
| **COMPLETE** | Process reset or new scan start | **INACTIVE** (ready for the next cycle) |

Additional conditions can force a transition to **INACTIVE** (or prevent entry into **ACTIVE**) when the **GasFlowOutOfRange** alarm (ID 1005) is raised, because the measured gas flow is outside the configured tolerance [Source: Alarm ID 1005].

In summary, the state machine moves from **INACTIVE → ACTIVE → TRANSMITTING → COMPLETE**, with the ability to **pause**, **resume**, or **abort** the process at any point via the corresponding events.

Questions.Question: Is spooling supported, and how is it configured?
Questions.Answer:
Yes. The device includes built‑in spooling functionality, as shown by the **SpoolActivated** event (ID 5600) and the **SpoolTransmitComplete** event (ID 5601) that report when spooling starts and when all spooled messages have been sent [Source: Event ID 5600] [Source: Event ID 5601].

Spooling is configured through a set of status variables:

* **SpoolCapacity** – defines the maximum configured spool buffer capacity in number of messages [Source: Status Variable ID 10014].  
* **SpoolState** – indicates the current spooling state (INACTIVE, ACTIVE, TRANSMITTING, COMPLETE) [Source: Status Variable ID 10012].  
* **SpoolCount** – shows how many messages are currently stored in the spool buffer [Source: Status Variable ID 10013].

Thus, spooling is supported and its operation is controlled by setting the spool buffer size (SpoolCapacity) and monitoring the state and count via the associated status variables.
